propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding a configurable maximum (default 8,000 characters) must block at both plan-review and completion-verification gates before any LLM call or context assembly.
Plan-review must return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false and completion-verification must return deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls when description size is exceeded.

The 8,000-character threshold is calibrated from historical replay of 2,202 tickets and affects only 0.82% of current tickets while capturing materially worse wall time and completion reliability in the 8–10K range.
Light-bug plan-review must partition DET blocks by retaining only P4 description findings as blocking while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory before the shared short circuit.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; P4 emits at most one oversize finding regardless of how many size signals are present.
Neither gate truncates or summarizes ticket content; oversized tickets must be decomposed by the operator before either gate runs.
